items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I was playing for Father Oswald.

ctx.x: See, Paul Barnes' wife was from down there. I was playing for Father Oswald. Which be down there practically every Saturday.

And who did you use in the band? What were you using in the band? George, George, Lawrence Moreira, Slow Dre, Paul Barnes, and Trumpet was Eulie Young. Oh yeah. You remember Eulie, eh? You remember Eulie, eh? You remember Eulie, eh? Yeah. You remember Eulie. You remember Eulie. Never knew him.
